svg.title: Four verdicts from one evidence archive
svg.desc: A sealed archive of three files travels to a verifier. Intact, it is verified, exit 0. A byte changed on the way breaks the seal: failed, exit 2. A required file lost on the way: not-established, exit 3. A changed verifier: the old verifier (v1) and the changed one (v2) both read the archive and both print verified, exit 0, and both receipts are filed side by side in one folder: both outcomes preserved. Exit codes: 0 verified, 2 failed, 3 not-established.
